dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and continuous 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminal point, ending in a sharp convergence.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins; slight asymmetrical bulge visible on the right lateral margin relative to the more linear left margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-intensity blue-grey shadows in the posterior region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse greyish clusters concentrated on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary white pigment and the darker greyish textural phases.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A linear series of small, low-contrast dark points or textural irregularities visible along the central longitudinal ridge.
